scope: Multi-binding public web proxies. Server-only build and rollout; installed agents and the published agent release remain 1.8.5.

features.bindings: 1–128 mixed owned machine-port and standalone HTTP(S) targets; stable IDs, labels, enable switches, reorder/priority, weights, Host-header policy and health-path overrides.
features.priority: Separate priority mode with manual order or automatic consecutive-failure/smoothed health-probe-latency selection.
features.balance: Separate load-balance mode with round robin, smooth weighted round robin, least active connections, optional one-day cookie affinity. Manual priorities do not restrict eligible bindings in balance mode.
features.health: Bounded active probes, passive failure detection, failed/passed-check thresholds, cooldown, status range, per-binding availability, latency and counters.
features.retries: Only empty GET/HEAD requests may retry. POST/uploads/upgrades are not replayed. Existing streams remain on their chosen binding. Default maximum 4 attempts, configurable from 1 to 128.
features.compatibility: Existing single-target records remain readable with passive-only checks; no data migration. Old single-target writes cannot erase an explicit pool.

checks.full_story: Exported production UI → authenticated local API → isolated MongoDB → generated routing snapshot → real edge → two real HTTP backends. Created mixed bindings, observed primary/backup failover, fresh owner-scoped health, automatic recovery, then round-robin routing after a browser edit.
checks.clippy: Runtime/API/edge lib+bins passed with existing warnings in public_access.rs/private_relay.rs/exposes.rs/exit_nodes.rs; no new upstream-pool warnings.
checks.other_checks: Existing proxy-row checks passed in both themes at 1512/402; proxy activity checks passed at 1512/402/320. A broader navigation script timed out in its group-dropdown check after proxy navigation checks; it is not counted as a pass.

deployment.health: Both updated roles healthy; HTTP health 200; observed descriptor use 450 of 65,536.
deployment.agent_heartbeats: EC2/Reid/Thor fresh at 1.8.5 after server rollout. No client update requested.
deployment.ibi: Observed a temporary listener reconnect during rollout; reattached automatically without a refresh click. HTTP 200 and OpenAPI SHA256 unchanged.
deployment.rollback: Protected before-config snapshot and old core/edge image tags retained on the gateway. No production test accounts or routes were created.

artifacts.server: Native ARM CI binaries validated against SHA256SUMS/source-revision, ELF architecture and absence of a dynamic loader.

limitations: Application sessions and data must be shared appropriately when balancing separate application instances.
A response already started cannot migrate to another binding; upgraded connections reconnect to use failover.
EC2 private DNS and inaccessible Condor/Harshitha investigation remain separate outstanding issues from the previous rollout.
